title: On Behaving better than anybody expected
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：behave　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 behave 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the porter ① behaved better than anybody expected twice over, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② behaves better than anybody expected year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ behave better than anybody expected at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ behaved better than anybody expected before — a line in the journal for August 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Behaving better than anybody expected twice over, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ behave in front of strangers year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Behave in front of strangers at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ behaves in front of strangers twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ behaved better than anybody expected again when nobody else would.

⑩ To behave better than anybody expected, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody behaves better than anybody expected year after year again and somebody must behave better than anybody expected twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 表现（一般过去式 behaved better than anybody expected：1981 年挑夫头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 表现（一般现在 behaves better than anybody expected：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 表现（不定式 to behave better than anybody expected：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 表现（过去完成时 had behaved better than anybody expected：1975 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 表现（动名词 behaving better than anybody expected 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 守规矩（behave in front of strangers：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去守规矩在生人面前守规矩）
G. v. 守规矩（behave in front of strangers：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 表现（后段两处：新来的游客照例 behaves in front of strangers，而母亲又一次 behaved better than anybody expected）

items.q: to behave better than anybody expected
behaved better than anybody expected before
behave in front of strangers year after year
behave in front of strangers at once
behaves in front of strangers twice over
behaved better than anybody expected again
to behave better than anybody expected

answers.why: behave 意为“表现”，1981 年挑夫来回两遍表现比谁预想的都好，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 behaved。
behave 意为“表现”，自那以后挑夫年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 behaves。
behave 意为“表现”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯表现比谁预想的都好”，此处为不定式 to behave better than anybody expected。
behave 意为“表现”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人表现过，故用过去完成时 had behaved。
behave 意为“表现”，挑夫说“表现比谁预想的都好这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 behaving better than anybody expected 作主语。
behave 意为“守规矩”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去守规矩在生人面前守规矩”，should ever 之后用原形 behave in front of strangers。
behave 意为“守规矩”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻守规矩在生人面前守规矩（behave in front of strangers at once），以后再也不要提起。
behave 意为“表现”，新来的游客每个星期都照例守规矩在生人面前守规矩，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 behaves。
behave 意为“表现”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍表现比谁预想的都好，用一般过去式 behaved 叙述。
behave 意为“表现”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要表现比谁预想的都好，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1981 年，挑夫来回两遍表现比谁预想的都好；海岸里每一个游客都说这是头一回。（behaved better than anybody expected）
多年以后，挑夫仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（behaves better than anybody expected）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯表现比谁预想的都好这件事本身。（to behave better than anybody expected）
早在 1975 年就有人表现比谁预想的都好，八月那天行记上的一行字就是证据。（had behaved better than anybody expected）
挑夫说过，来回两遍表现比谁预想的都好这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（behaving better than anybody expected 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻守规矩在生人面前守规矩，以后再也不要提起。（behave in front of strangers，祈使句）
answers: In 1981 the porter behaved better than anybody expected twice over, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the porter still behaves better than anybody expected year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to behave better than anybody expected at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had behaved better than anybody expected long before 1988, and the line in the journal for August proves it.
Behaving better than anybody expected twice over, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Behave in front of strangers at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 behave 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the porter behaved better than anybody expected twice over, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter behaves better than anybody expected year after year whenever the coast asks.
Behaving better than anybody expected twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever behave in front of strangers year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast behaves in front of strangers twice over every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother behaved better than anybody expected again, and the coast remembered that half.
